caption_L1: This bar chart is labeled Consumer price index (CPI) of beer annually in the Netherlands from 2009 to 2019. Along the y-axis, Year is measured. The x-axis measures Consumer price index (2015=100)*.
caption_L2L3: The CPI of beer in the Netherlands stays fairly consistent throughout 2009-2019. It begins to increase but then decreases back again after 2014. The CPI is the lowest in 2009 at 85 and is the highest in 2014.
